name: Open Redirect from Request Parameter (Servlet/Spring)
attack_scenario: A crafted link https://trusted.example/login?url=https://evil.example points at the trusted host, so the victim trusts it; after login the app bounces them to the attacker's phishing/token-harvest page, or a //evil.example value leaks the OAuth code/session to the attacker's origin.
negative_test_hint: request the login flow with url param "https://evil.example.com" and assert the redirect falls back to a relative path instead of leaving the origin

exemplar.explanation: Redirecting straight to a request parameter lets an attacker point a trusted-host link at a phishing origin, or leak an OAuth code or session via a scheme-relative //host target. Validating the target into a local variable first — requiring a relative path that does not start with // — keeps every redirect on the application's own origin.
